# Clouds provenance

Stratus is a fixed-point reimplementation of the Clouds DSP from
[pichenettes/eurorack](https://github.com/pichenettes/eurorack) at
`f4cfa7697095a28d292bff758beb51deb49b5a86` (stmlib at
`d18def816c51d1da0c108236928b2bbd25c17481`), MIT, copyright Emilie Gillet
([LICENSE](LICENSE)). Clouds computes in floating point, which the OP-XY's
Blackfin does not have, so no upstream file is vendored verbatim: each Stratus
file follows the upstream code it names, formula for formula.

| Stratus | Upstream |
| --- | --- |
| [clouds.h](../clouds.h) | `clouds/dsp/granular_processor.cc` (`Process`, `ProcessGranular`, the granular part of `Prepare`), `granular_sample_player.h`, `grain.h`, `audio_buffer.h` (16-bit `WriteFade`, `ReadLinear`, `ReadHermite`), `fx/diffuser.h`, `fx/reverb.h`, `fx/fx_engine.h`, `cv_scaler.cc` (Pitch), stmlib `Svf`, `CosineOscillator` and `Random` |
| [core.h](../core.h) | The state of `GranularProcessor` and its players in its 16-bit stereo quality |
| [fx.cpp](../fx.cpp) | `GranularProcessor::Init`, and the codec's 16-bit input and output |
| [tables.h](../tables.h) | `clouds/resources/lookup_tables.py`, regenerated by the repository's `tools/clouds_tables.py` |
| [fixed.h](../fixed.h) | stmlib `SoftLimit`, `Random` and `SemitonesToRatio` |
